description: This PHP class defines a custom Twig node expression for handling enum cases. It extends the FunctionExpression class and compiles a call to an enum's cases method if the first argument is a valid string representing an enum name. It includes validation to ensure the argument is a string and that the enum exists.

classes.name: EnumCasesFunction
classes.description: Custom Twig node expression class for handling enum cases, extends FunctionExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the enum_cases function, verifying its argument and emitting the corresponding enum cases method call.
